scripts.build: pnpm --filter @parksplash/shared build && pnpm --filter @parksplash/web build && pnpm --filter @parksplash/cms build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @parksplash/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @parksplash/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @parksplash/cms typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @parksplash/shared build && pnpm --filter @parksplash/web build && pnpm --filter @parksplash/cms build
